description: In a countable language, the formulas over countably many names, with their finite context sizes recorded, form a countable set.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.instCountableSigmaNat.{u, v, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'}
  [Countable α] [Countable L.Symbols] : Countable ((n : ℕ) × L.BoundedFormula α n)
